desc: Paper notes taken back on the Start menu's page (TTYD_NOTES_PAGE, TTYD_NOTES_TEST: no relay; the test answers with the relay's rules): two notes left where Mario stands, then the nearest of them chosen once (the help asks: chosen again, it is taken back) and again: taken back, forgotten in notes.txt, gone from the list; Refresh then finds one of yours (and the far note someone else left)
log_must: ^\[notes\] test: add gor_00 .*: Your note is left here\.\n(?:.*\n)*?\[notes\] test: add gor_00 .*: Your note is left here\.
^\[notes\] page: take back t1\? \(chosen again, it is\)$
^\[notes\] test: take gor_00 t1: Your note is taken back\.$
^\[notes\] test: refresh: 2 notes in gor, 1 yours$
log_must_not: ^\[notes\] page: take back t1\? .*\n(?:.*\n)*?\[notes\] page: take back t1\?
